title: gorillionaire
tagline: Gorillionaire is an AI trading agent using Eliza for real-time analysis and Coinbase AgentKit for execution. The AI agent manages an ERC-4626 vault, optimizing meme coin trades based on on-chain and off-chain data for secure and efficient asset management.
description:
Gorillionaire: AI-Powered On-Chain Trading on Base
Gorillionaire is a fully autonomous AI-driven trading system designed to navigate high-volatility memecoin markets on Base. By integrating Eliza AI for decision-making and Coinbase’s AgentKit for execution, it enables on-chain trades in real-time, leveraging price action with social sentiment, and on-chain activity to generate high-confidence trading signals.

A small presentation of the project: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1U9T246tEBU1PaRnKn-Ai0rMWj0w0WzeA4e9yxxTNqSU/edit?usp=sharing

Core Architecture & Capabilities
AI-Powered Decision-Making
On-Chain AI Trading Agent – Generates BUY, SELL, or HOLD signals based on price trends, social sentiment, and liquidity shifts.
Modular & Extensible Design – Supports custom AI models that process on-chain data, allowing for adaptive strategy development.
Advanced Market Intelligence
Data-Driven Insights – Tracks short-term & long-term momentum, volatility patterns, and liquidity shifts to detect potential breakouts.
Monitors Twitter, Discord, and price activity to identify market-moving narratives before they impact price action.
Confidence-Weighted Trading Signals – Computes risk-adjusted probabilities to maximize trading accuracy.

Secure & Risk-Aware Trading
ERC-4626 Vault Protection – Funds remain within a allowlisted vault, ensuring controlled swaps and no unauthorized transactions.
Rugpull Detection Engine – AI scans smart contract activity and liquidity movements to mitigate/anticipate potential scams before losses occur.
Optimized Execution & Real-Time Performance
Custom AgentKit Actions – Built Gorilli_Trade_Meme, which calls our Uniswap V2 trading contract for efficient, automated swaps.
Automated Vault Deployment – Developed Gorilli_Trade & Gorilli_Create_ERC4626_Vault actions, ensuring seamless strategy execution.
Gas-Optimized Trading – Uses AgentKit’s low-cost transaction handling to execute trades efficiently.
Hyper-Fast Market Reactions – CoinMarketCap integration provides real-time price tracking to execute trades with millisecond-level precision.
Multi-Channel Intelligence & Dynamic Adaptation
AI-Powered Sentiment Tracking – Eliza continuously analyzes Discord, Twitter, and blockchain data for trading signals.
Real-Time Market Adaptation – AI adjusts trade execution strategies dynamically based on live market conditions.
Deep On-Chain Integration – Uses on-chain event monitoring to identify liquidity trends, large trades, and transaction spikes.
how_its_made:
Core AI & Execution Framework

Eliza AI Client
We built a custom AI framework that ingests real-time market data, analyzes multiple sources, and generates actionable trading signals. It continuously monitors social activities, on-chain transactions, and price feeds, creating an algorithm to generate BUY, SELL, or HOLD decisions.

Custom AgentKit Actions
We developed proprietary execution logic within Coinbase AgentKit to enable AI-driven on-chain trading, ensuring seamless execution from the Agent via Eliza. Our custom-built actions include:

Gorilli_Trade_Meme – Calls our contract that executes Uniswap V2 swaps for memecoin trading.
Gorilli_Trade – A generalized AI-driven trade execution logic, optimized for slippage control and liquidity efficiency.
Gorilli_Create_ERC4626_Vault – Enables automated vault deployment, allowing secure asset management for decentralized trading strategies.

AgentKit v0.0.11 – Due to compatibility issues, we had to revert to v0.0.11, leading to better stability in our execution pipeline.
This deep integration between Eliza and AgentKit now allows us to easily upgrade our trading models without modifying execution logic.

Market Intelligence & Multi-Source Data Aggregation
Social & On-Chain Monitoring
Discord & Twitter Plugins – Real-time analysis of social sentiment, meme trends, and trader psychology.
On-Chain Activity Scanner – Detects liquidity shifts, whale movements, and anomalous transaction spikes (percentChange1h, percentChange24h, volume24h, volumeChange24h).
Gorillionaire Client – A custom-built internal data interface for visualizing and analyzing market trends in real-time.
AI-Powered Decision making
Rugpull Detection Engine – Uses AI-powered anomaly detection that can flag potential scams, exit liquidity movements, and wash trading patterns.

Infrastructure & Execution Layer

Coinbase AgentKit
AI-driven automation, allowing Eliza’s trading signals to execute instantly.
Seamless ERC-4626 vault integration, ensuring secure and programmable asset storage.

MongoDB Adapter
Historical trade tracking to refine AI models.
Market sentiment & trend storage, allowing future time-series analysis of crypto narratives.
Real-time AI decision caching, enabling faster trade execution.
AI & Machine Learning Capabilities

Real-Time Market Data Feeds
CoinMarketCap Plugin – Delivers accurate price tracking, allowing hyper-fast trade reactions.

ERC-4626 Vault Protection
Funds remain within a secure, allowlisted vault, ensuring:
Controlled token swaps, preventing unauthorized transactions.
No speculative or high-risk interactions, reducing potential exploits.

Hacky & Notable Aspects
1. Adapting AgentKit for AI-Driven Execution
We discovered compatibility issues in newer AgentKit versions, forcing us to revert to v0.0.11. This led to deeper insights into how Eliza and AgentKit interact, allowing us to streamline future updates effortlessly.

2. Gas-Optimized Memecoin Trading via Uniswap V2
Rather than using default AgentKit trading actions, we built a custom swap execution layer using Uniswap V2 contracts. This reduced gas costs and enabled more precise trade control.

3. AI-Powered Social Sentiment Tracking
Unlike traditional bots that rely purely on price action, Gorillionaire stores social narratives, allowing it to trade ahead of price movements.

4. Full On-Chain Deployment on Base
We successfully deployed Gorillionaire Vault on Base, trading BRETT memecoin and demonstrating real-world application of AI-driven trading strategies.

Final Thoughts
By integrating AI-driven market intelligence and on-chain security mechanisms, we think that with Gorillionaire we have designed a new way for autonomous DeFi trading.
